fact_text: The Special Investment Facilitation Council was reported to be meeting refineries on 18 Sep 2025 on sales-tax and GST issues; the video notes the date in the paper was 18 Sep.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 17 Sep 2025 | SIFC Refineries Talks | NRL & Attock Refinery Outlook | TOMCL  Growth' (YouTube, 2025-09-17)

fact_text: Refineries asked for the sales-tax concession to end so they can recover sales tax paid on imported machinery through fuel sales, but the government had not accepted this for months.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 17 Sep 2025 | SIFC Refineries Talks | NRL & Attock Refinery Outlook | TOMCL  Growth' (YouTube, 2025-09-17)

fact_text: Ex-refinery prices were reported to have fallen in the quarter ending September 2025, which the analyst said weighs on refinery results.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 17 Sep 2025 | SIFC Refineries Talks | NRL & Attock Refinery Outlook | TOMCL  Growth' (YouTube, 2025-09-17)

fact_text: The analyst described a possible V-shaped recovery for refineries if furnace-oil content falls and higher-value light product yields improve, as management changes take effect.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 17 Sep 2025 | SIFC Refineries Talks | NRL & Attock Refinery Outlook | TOMCL  Growth' (YouTube, 2025-09-17)

fact_text: National Refinery's Q1 FY26 results could improve on the prior quarter, according to the analyst, after management changes at the coastal refinery.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 17 Sep 2025 | SIFC Refineries Talks | NRL & Attock Refinery Outlook | TOMCL  Growth' (YouTube, 2025-09-17)

fact_text: Pakistan Refinery was also expected by the analyst to show a modest improvement over the prior quarter in Q1 FY26, as a coastal refinery in recovery mode.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 17 Sep 2025 | SIFC Refineries Talks | NRL & Attock Refinery Outlook | TOMCL  Growth' (YouTube, 2025-09-17)

fact_text: Attock Refinery is a mid-country refinery that gets its crude supply from its parent, Pakistan Oilfields, and holds a large cash balance on its books.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 17 Sep 2025 | SIFC Refineries Talks | NRL & Attock Refinery Outlook | TOMCL  Growth' (YouTube, 2025-09-17)

fact_text: The analyst saw Attock Refinery's position as stronger than the coastal refineries', because its crude supply is secured through its parent company.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 17 Sep 2025 | SIFC Refineries Talks | NRL & Attock Refinery Outlook | TOMCL  Growth' (YouTube, 2025-09-17)

fact_text: The Organic Meat Company received a PSX notice after it met Chinese standards for its frozen-meat exports to China, which the analyst said is a large market.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 17 Sep 2025 | SIFC Refineries Talks | NRL & Attock Refinery Outlook | TOMCL  Growth' (YouTube, 2025-09-17)

fact_text: The Organic Meat Company is described as one of the top names in Pakistan's meat export business, with exports to the Gulf that predate its China push.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 17 Sep 2025 | SIFC Refineries Talks | NRL & Attock Refinery Outlook | TOMCL  Growth' (YouTube, 2025-09-17)

fact_text: The analyst said demand for older animal meat, offal and other by-products from China and Central Asia is a growth driver for the Organic Meat Company.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 17 Sep 2025 | SIFC Refineries Talks | NRL & Attock Refinery Outlook | TOMCL  Growth' (YouTube, 2025-09-17)

fact_text: The Organic Meat Company's final-quarter FY25 results were still awaited as of mid-September 2025, and the analyst expected gradual gains at the top and bottom line.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 17 Sep 2025 | SIFC Refineries Talks | NRL & Attock Refinery Outlook | TOMCL  Growth' (YouTube, 2025-09-17)

fact_text: The analyst said Pakistan's meat quality is valued in Gulf markets, and that rural livestock culture and slaughterhouse growth make the meat export business attractive.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 17 Sep 2025 | SIFC Refineries Talks | NRL & Attock Refinery Outlook | TOMCL  Growth' (YouTube, 2025-09-17)

fact_text: In mid-September 2025 the analyst described the broad market as moving sideways, and he said Pakistan's growth drivers had yet to emerge.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 17 Sep 2025 | SIFC Refineries Talks | NRL & Attock Refinery Outlook | TOMCL  Growth' (YouTube, 2025-09-17)

fact_text: The analyst noted the State Bank policy rate stayed unchanged, and he linked the lack of a rate move to growth drivers that had not yet appeared.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 17 Sep 2025 | SIFC Refineries Talks | NRL & Attock Refinery Outlook | TOMCL  Growth' (YouTube, 2025-09-17)
